ex.en: He shared his box of biscuits with all his friends.
ex.zh: 他和他所有的朋友分享了他的那盒餅乾。

ex.en: Christmas is a time for giving and sharing.
ex.zh: 聖誕節是給予和分享的時節。

ex.en: To share one's passion is to live it fully.
ex.zh: 分享你的熱情，就是充分地活出它。

share.en: to give part of what you have to other people

ex.en: He shares a room with his brother.
ex.zh: 他和他兄弟共用一個房間。

ex.en: More and more married couples share household chores.
ex.zh: 越來越多夫妻一起分擔家事。

share.en: to use something together with another person, or to take part of a cost or duty

ex.en: She owns shares in several tech companies.
ex.zh: 她持有好幾家科技公司的股份。

ex.en: The company's shares rose by 5% today.
ex.zh: 這家公司的股價今天上漲 5%。

share.en: one of the equal parts of a company that people can buy and own

ex.en: Shortly after the accident, the police came.
ex.zh: 事故發生後不久，警察就來了。

ex.en: Tom will join us shortly.
ex.zh: 湯姆很快就會來跟我們會合。

ex.en: The meeting will begin shortly.
ex.zh: 會議即將開始。

shortly.en: soon, or not long after a time in the past

ex.en: Black Friday sales attract shoppers.
ex.zh: 黑色星期五的特賣吸引了許多購物人潮。

ex.en: Shoppers crowded the streets.
ex.zh: 街上擠滿了購物的人。

ex.en: Online shoppers can return items within 30 days.
ex.zh: 網購顧客可以在三十天內退貨。

shopper.en: a person who buys things in stores

ex.en: We visited the car showroom on Saturday.
ex.zh: 我們星期六去了汽車展示中心。

ex.en: The furniture is on display in our showroom.
ex.zh: 這些家具在我們的展示間展示。

showroom.en: a large room where products such as cars are shown to buyers

ex.en: I shortened my speeches.
ex.zh: 我把演講縮短了。

ex.en: Can you shorten this report to two pages?
ex.zh: 你可以把這份報告縮短成兩頁嗎？

ex.en: The meeting was shortened to 30 minutes.
ex.zh: 會議縮短為三十分鐘。

shorten.en: to make something less long, or to become less long

ex.en: Corporate earnings in the first quarter improved sharply.
ex.zh: 企業第一季獲利大幅改善。

ex.en: Industrial production rose sharply in July.
ex.zh: 七月工業生產大幅成長。

ex.en: Housing prices in Hsinchu City have risen sharply due to the concentration of the tech industry.
ex.zh: 新竹市的房價因科技產業聚集而大幅上漲。

sharply.en: by a large amount and very quickly

ex.en: She spoke sharply to the staff.
ex.zh: 她對員工說話很嚴厲。

ex.en: The plan was sharply criticized by experts.
ex.zh: 這個計畫遭到專家嚴厲批評。

ex.en: Fruit that has been left for a long time will shrink.
ex.zh: 水果放太久就會乾癟。

ex.en: My sweater shrank in the wash.
ex.zh: 我的毛衣洗了以後縮水了。

ex.en: The company's market share has shrunk this year.
ex.zh: 公司今年的市占率縮小了。

shrink.en: to become smaller in size or amount

ex.en: You need to shed some pounds.
ex.zh: 你需要減掉幾磅。

ex.en: The company plans to shed 500 jobs this year.
ex.zh: 公司計畫今年裁減 500 個職位。

shed.en: to get rid of something you do not want, such as weight or workers

ex.en: She shed tears.
ex.zh: 她流下了眼淚。

ex.en: Nobody's going to shed any tears if that old building gets torn down.
ex.zh: 那棟舊大樓要是被拆了，也沒有人會覺得可惜。

shed.en: to let tears fall from your eyes

shed.zh: shed light on：使…更清楚、闡明

ex.en: The report sheds light on the causes of the problem.
ex.zh: 這份報告釐清了問題的成因。

ex.en: Can you shed some light on this issue?
ex.zh: 你能幫忙說明一下這個問題嗎？

shed.en: to help people understand something by giving new information about it

ex.en: Tom hid in the shed.
ex.zh: 湯姆躲在小屋裡。

ex.en: We keep our bikes in the shed.
ex.zh: 我們把腳踏車放在小屋裡。

shed.en: a small simple building used for keeping tools or other things

ex.en: The police officers held up their shields.
ex.zh: 警察舉起盾牌。

ex.en: The screen acts as a shield against the sun.
ex.zh: 這塊屏幕可以遮擋陽光。

shield.en: a flat object held to protect the body, or anything that protects

ex.en: She shielded her eyes from the sun.
ex.zh: 她用手遮住眼睛擋太陽。

ex.en: Parents can't shield their children from every problem.
ex.zh: 父母無法替孩子擋下所有問題。

shield.en: to protect someone or something from harm or danger

ex.en: The company faces a budget shortfall of two million dollars.
ex.zh: 公司面臨兩百萬美元的預算缺口。

ex.en: We need to cover the shortfall in staff.
ex.zh: 我們需要補足人力的不足。

shortfall.en: the amount by which something is less than what you need

sheer.zh: 純粹的、完全的；（數量）龐大的

ex.en: It is a sheer waste of time.
ex.zh: 這完全是浪費時間。

ex.en: He succeeded through sheer hard work.
ex.zh: 他完全是靠努力成功的。

ex.en: The sheer size of the stadium amazed us.
ex.zh: 體育場的規模之大讓我們驚嘆。

sheer.en: complete and nothing else, or very great in amount

ex.en: She put two pairs of sheer tights in the suitcase.
ex.zh: 她在行李箱裡放了兩雙透膚褲襪。

ex.en: She wore a sheer white blouse.
ex.zh: 她穿了一件薄透的白襯衫。

sheer.en: very thin so that you can see through it

ex.en: He showed me the manuscript of his new play.
ex.zh: 他給我看了他新劇本的手稿。

ex.en: Would you show us some samples of your work?
ex.zh: 可以給我們看一些你的作品樣本嗎？

ex.en: That shows how little we know of ourselves.
ex.zh: 這說明我們對自己了解得很少。

ex.en: My data-burning software is showing an error message.
ex.zh: 我的燒錄軟體顯示了一則錯誤訊息。

show.en: to make a fact or feeling clear to people

ex.en: Let me show you around the office.
ex.zh: 我帶你參觀一下辦公室。

ex.en: Can you show me the way to the station?
ex.zh: 你可以告訴我去車站怎麼走嗎？

show.en: to take someone to a place and guide them around it

ex.en: Let's have lunch downtown and take in a show.
ex.zh: 我們去市區吃午餐，順便看場表演吧。

ex.en: What's your favorite TV show?
ex.zh: 你最喜歡的電視節目是什麼？

show.en: a performance on stage or television, or a public display of things

ex.en: A rabbit has long ears and a short tail.
ex.zh: 兔子有長耳朵和短尾巴。

ex.en: Is there a shorter road to get there?
ex.zh: 有比較近的路可以到那裡嗎？

ex.en: I wonder which way is the shortest.
ex.zh: 我想知道哪條路最近。

short.en: not long in length or distance

ex.en: He is short but very strong.
ex.zh: 他個子矮但很強壯。

ex.en: My brother is shorter than me.
ex.zh: 我弟弟比我矮。

ex.en: Let's take a short break.
ex.zh: 我們稍微休息一下吧。

ex.en: Please keep your answer short.
ex.zh: 請簡短回答。

short.en: lasting only a small amount of time

ex.en: We are not short of oil in this country.
ex.zh: 我們國家不缺石油。

ex.en: We are short of staff this week.
ex.zh: 我們這週人手不足。

ex.en: The shop is just in front of the station.
ex.zh: 那家店就在車站正前方。

ex.en: There are a few shops next to my house.
ex.zh: 我家旁邊有幾家商店。

ex.en: My uncle has a flower shop near the station.
ex.zh: 我叔叔在車站附近開了一家花店。

shop.en: a place where people go to buy things

ex.en: I usually shop online.
ex.zh: 我通常在網路上買東西。

ex.en: We went shopping at the mall.
ex.zh: 我們去購物中心逛街。

shop.en: to go to stores or websites to buy things

ex.en: The house stood out because of its unusual shape.
ex.zh: 那棟房子因為形狀特殊而很顯眼。

ex.en: That cloud is in the shape of a fish.
ex.zh: 那片雲是魚的形狀。

ex.en: The earth is similar to an orange in shape.
ex.zh: 地球的形狀和柳橙很像。

shape.en: the outer form of something, such as a circle or square

ex.en: I need to get back in shape.
ex.zh: 我需要把身材練回來。

ex.en: The old car is still in good shape.
ex.zh: 那台舊車的狀況還很好。

shape.en: the physical condition of a person or thing

ex.en: This fruit is shaped like an orange and tastes like a pineapple.
ex.zh: 這種水果形狀像柳橙，吃起來像鳳梨。

ex.en: Our experiences shape who we are.
ex.zh: 我們的經歷塑造了我們。

shape.en: to give something a particular form

ex.en: She shoots at paper targets at the archery club every Sunday.
ex.zh: 她每個星期天都在射箭俱樂部射紙靶。

ex.en: The guard was trained to shoot only as a last resort.
ex.zh: 警衛受過訓練，只有在萬不得已時才開槍。

shoot.en: to fire a gun or send an arrow at something

ex.en: The movie was shot in Taiwan.
ex.zh: 這部電影是在台灣拍攝的。

ex.en: We're shooting a video for our new product.
ex.zh: 我們正在為新產品拍一支影片。

shoot.en: to make a film or take photographs

ex.en: He shot the ball from the middle of the court.
ex.zh: 他從中場投籃。

ex.en: She shot and scored in the last minute.
ex.zh: 她在最後一分鐘射門得分。

shoot.en: to throw or kick a ball toward the goal to score

ex.en: The photo shoot took all afternoon.
ex.zh: 拍照花了一整個下午。

ex.en: We have a shoot at the studio tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我們明天在攝影棚有拍攝工作。

shoot.en: a session of taking photographs or making a film

ex.en: It was a great shock to me.
ex.zh: 這對我是很大的打擊。

ex.en: His death was great shock to his wife.
ex.zh: 他的死讓他太太大受打擊。

ex.en: She got over the shock of her father's death.
ex.zh: 她從父親過世的打擊中走了出來。

shock.en: a sudden strong feeling of surprise or upset caused by something bad

ex.en: My dad was completely shocked by my silly question.
ex.zh: 我爸完全被我的蠢問題嚇到了。

ex.en: What shocked us greatly was his sudden resignation.
ex.zh: 讓我們非常震驚的是他突然辭職。

shock.en: to make someone feel very surprised and upset

ex.en: Don't touch the wire, or you'll get a shock.
ex.zh: 別碰那條電線，不然會觸電。

ex.en: I got an electric shock from the old toaster.
ex.zh: 我被那台舊烤麵包機電到了。

shock.en: a sudden painful feeling caused by electricity passing through the body

ex.en: We felt the house shake a little.
ex.zh: 我們感覺房子搖晃了一下。

ex.en: My hands were shaking too much to thread the needle.
ex.zh: 我的手抖得太厲害，沒辦法穿針。

ex.en: Speak the truth, even if your voice shakes.
ex.zh: 即使聲音發抖，也要說出實話。

shake.en: to move quickly up and down or from side to side

ex.en: I entered the room and shook hands with him.
ex.zh: 我走進房間和他握手。

ex.en: I'll never forget shaking the President's hand last year.
ex.zh: 我永遠不會忘記去年和總統握手的那一刻。

shake.en: to hold another person's hand as a greeting

ex.en: Put on your shoes. Let's go out for dinner.
ex.zh: 穿上鞋子，我們出去吃晚餐。

ex.en: Do I have to take off my shoes here?
ex.zh: 在這裡要脫鞋嗎？

ex.en: Wait a second. My shoe is untied.
ex.zh: 等一下，我的鞋帶鬆了。

shoe.en: a covering for the foot that you wear when you walk outside

ex.en: That's a great shot of the sunset.
ex.zh: 那張夕陽照拍得很棒。

ex.en: The opening shot of the movie is beautiful.
ex.zh: 這部電影的開場鏡頭很美。

shot.en: a photograph, or a short piece of film

shot.zh: 嘗試（give it a shot 試試看）

ex.en: I've never tried surfing, but I'll give it a shot.
ex.zh: 我從沒衝過浪，但我會試試看。

ex.en: It's a long shot, but it's worth a try.
ex.zh: 希望不大，但值得一試。

ex.en: Did you get your flu shot this year?
ex.zh: 你今年打流感疫苗了嗎？

ex.en: The nurse gave me a shot in the arm.
ex.zh: 護理師在我手臂上打了一針。

shot.en: an amount of medicine put into the body with a needle

ex.en: All at once we heard a shot outside.
ex.zh: 我們突然聽見外面一聲槍響。

ex.en: He fired three shots.
ex.zh: 他開了三槍。

shot.en: the act of firing a gun, or the sound it makes

ex.en: I felt somebody pat me on the shoulder.
ex.zh: 我感覺有人拍了拍我的肩膀。

ex.en: He put a hand gently on her shoulder.
ex.zh: 他把手輕輕放在她的肩上。

ex.en: A great responsibility lies on his shoulders.
ex.zh: 他肩負著重大的責任。

shoulder.en: the part of the body between the neck and the arm

ex.en: She had to shoulder the responsibility alone.
ex.zh: 她必須獨自承擔這個責任。

ex.en: Taxpayers will shoulder the cost of the project.
ex.zh: 這個計畫的費用將由納稅人負擔。

shoulder.en: to accept a duty, blame or cost

ex.en: She put clean sheets on the bed.
ex.zh: 她在床上鋪了乾淨的床單。

ex.en: You put away the sheets, and I'll make the bed.
ex.zh: 你把床單收好，我來鋪床。

sheet.en: a large piece of cloth that you lie on or under in bed

ex.en: She pressed her nose against the sheet of glass.
ex.zh: 她把鼻子貼在玻璃上。

ex.en: Please write your name on a sheet of paper.
ex.zh: 請在一張紙上寫下你的名字。

sheet.en: a thin flat piece of paper, glass or metal

ex.en: Fill in your time sheet every Friday.
ex.zh: 每週五要填寫工時表。

ex.en: Check the fact sheet for product details.
ex.zh: 產品細節請參考資料表。

sheet.en: a page of paper with information or spaces to fill in

ex.en: I heard someone shout outside the window.
ex.zh: 我聽到窗外有人大叫。

ex.en: Shouting at your computer will not help.
ex.zh: 對電腦大吼一點用都沒有。

ex.en: He shouted at the top of his lungs.
ex.zh: 他放聲大喊。

ex.en: We heard a shout from upstairs.
ex.zh: 我們聽到樓上傳來一聲喊叫。

ex.en: She gave a shout of joy.
ex.zh: 她高興地大叫了一聲。

ex.en: "Would you mind shutting the door?" "No, not at all."
ex.zh: 「你介意把門關上嗎？」「不介意，沒問題。」

ex.en: Just pull the door shut. It'll lock by itself.
ex.zh: 把門拉上就好，它會自動上鎖。

ex.en: Please shut the window. It's cold.
ex.zh: 請把窗戶關上，好冷。

shut.en: to move something so that it covers an opening

shut.zh: shut down：關閉；停止運作、關機

ex.en: Heads up! The server will shut down at midnight.
ex.zh: 注意！伺服器會在午夜關機。

ex.en: Skype is shutting down in May of 2025.
ex.zh: Skype 將在 2025 年 5 月停止服務。

shut.en: to stop working, or to make a business or machine stop working

ex.en: Be careful, that knife is very sharp.
ex.zh: 小心，那把刀很利。

ex.en: Use a sharp pencil for the drawing.
ex.zh: 畫這張圖要用削尖的鉛筆。

sharp.en: having a thin edge or point that can cut or pierce

ex.en: There was a sharp rise in sales last month.
ex.zh: 上個月業績急劇上升。

ex.en: The road makes a sharp turn ahead.
ex.zh: 前方道路有個急轉彎。

ex.en: His observations are sharp, but he doesn't say much.
ex.zh: 他的觀察很敏銳，但話不多。

ex.en: She has a sharp mind for business.
ex.zh: 她很有商業頭腦。

sharp.en: quick to notice and understand things

ex.en: Be at the station at 11 o'clock sharp.
ex.zh: 十一點整到車站。

ex.en: The meeting starts at nine o'clock sharp.
ex.zh: 會議九點整開始。

ex.en: This shirt doesn't go with that tie at all.
ex.zh: 這件襯衫跟那條領帶完全不搭。

ex.en: In the summer I wear short-sleeved shirts.
ex.zh: 夏天我穿短袖襯衫。

ex.en: The second button of your shirt is coming off.
ex.zh: 你襯衫的第二顆扣子快掉了。

shirt.en: a piece of clothing for the upper body with a collar and sleeves

ex.en: He is afraid of his own shadow.
ex.zh: 他連自己的影子都怕。

ex.en: Zebra shadows don't have stripes.
ex.zh: 斑馬的影子沒有條紋。

shadow.en: a dark shape made when something blocks the light

ex.en: What is lurking in the shadows?
ex.zh: 陰暗處潛伏著什麼？

ex.en: By late afternoon, the garden was in shadow.
ex.zh: 到了傍晚，花園已籠罩在陰影中。

shadow.en: a dark area where light does not reach

shadow.zh: 跟隨見習（觀摩他人工作）

ex.en: New employees shadow a senior colleague for a week.
ex.zh: 新員工會跟著資深同事見習一週。

ex.en: Can I shadow you at work tomorrow?
ex.zh: 我明天可以跟在你身邊見習嗎？

shadow.en: to follow a person at work in order to learn how they do their job

ex.en: The shareholders approved the merger.
ex.zh: 股東們通過了這項合併案。

ex.en: The annual shareholder meeting will be held in June.
ex.zh: 年度股東大會將在六月舉行。

shareholder.en: a person who owns part of a company

ex.en: The phone rang while I was taking a shower.
ex.zh: 我在洗澡時電話響了。

ex.en: I didn't have time to take a shower today.
ex.zh: 我今天沒時間沖澡。

ex.en: She prefers baths rather than showers.
ex.zh: 比起沖澡，她更喜歡泡澡。

shower.en: a wash under falling water, or the place where you do it

ex.en: I was showering a moment ago.
ex.zh: 我剛剛在洗澡。

ex.en: I usually shower in the morning.
ex.zh: 我通常早上沖澡。

shower.en: to wash yourself under falling water

ex.en: Expect a few showers this afternoon.
ex.zh: 今天下午預計會有幾陣雨。

ex.en: We got caught in a shower on the way home.
ex.zh: 我們回家路上遇到一陣雨。

shower.en: a short period of light rain

ex.en: He showered her with compliments.
ex.zh: 他對她讚不絕口。

ex.en: The fans showered the singer with flowers.
ex.zh: 歌迷向那位歌手獻上大量鮮花。

shower.en: to give someone a lot of something

ex.en: Are you sure the book is on this shelf?
ex.zh: 你確定那本書在這個書架上嗎？

ex.en: You have too many books on the shelf.
ex.zh: 你書架上的書太多了。

ex.en: Can't you reach the book on the shelf?
ex.zh: 你拿不到架子上的那本書嗎？

shelf.en: a flat board fixed to a wall or in a cupboard for keeping things on

shelf.zh: on the shelf / off the shelf：上架、現成可買的

ex.en: The new product will be on the shelves next month.
ex.zh: 新產品下個月就會上架。

ex.en: We bought the software off the shelf.
ex.zh: 我們買的是現成的套裝軟體。

shelf.en: for sale in a shop, or ready-made and not specially produced

ex.en: I picked up a pretty shell at the seaside.
ex.zh: 我在海邊撿到一個漂亮的貝殼。

ex.en: The shell of an egg is easily broken.
ex.zh: 蛋殼很容易破。

ex.en: The snail retreated into its shell.
ex.zh: 蝸牛縮回殼裡去了。

shell.en: the hard outer covering of a sea animal, egg or nut

ex.en: Can you help me shell the peanuts?
ex.zh: 你可以幫我剝花生嗎？

ex.en: She shelled the shrimp before cooking them.
ex.zh: 她煮蝦子前先把殼剝掉。

shell.en: to take the hard outer covering off a nut or egg

ex.en: We're going to set up shelters.
ex.zh: 我們要搭建避難所。

ex.en: We adopted our dog from an animal shelter.
ex.zh: 我們的狗是從動物收容所領養的。

shelter.en: a place where people stay safe when they have no home or are in danger

ex.en: I had to take shelter under a tree.
ex.zh: 我只好在樹下躲雨。

ex.en: Children depend on their parents for food, clothing and shelter.
ex.zh: 孩子們的衣食住都要依靠父母。

ex.en: We took shelter from the storm in a café.
ex.zh: 我們躲進一家咖啡廳避暴風雨。

shelter.en: protection from bad weather or danger

ex.en: These flowers should be sheltered from the rain.
ex.zh: 這些花應該要遮雨。

ex.en: The trees shelter the house from the wind.
ex.zh: 樹木替房子擋風。

shelter.en: to keep someone or something safe from bad weather or danger

ex.en: This is a world where the sun doesn't shine.
ex.zh: 這是一個沒有陽光的世界。

ex.en: The clouds opened and the sun shone through.
ex.zh: 雲散開了，陽光照了進來。

ex.en: If only that lamp weren't shining in my eye.
ex.zh: 要是那盞燈沒照到我眼睛就好了。

ex.en: Susan shined her father's shoes.
ex.zh: 蘇珊把她爸爸的鞋子擦亮了。

ex.en: He shines his shoes every morning.
ex.zh: 他每天早上擦亮鞋子。

shine.en: to rub something until it looks bright

ex.en: She really shines in math.
ex.zh: 她在數學方面表現特別出色。

ex.en: This is your chance to shine.
ex.zh: 這是你大顯身手的機會。

ex.en: Tom closed his eyes and began to count sheep.
ex.zh: 湯姆閉上眼睛開始數羊。

ex.en: Tom's uncle keeps a lot of sheep.
ex.zh: 湯姆的叔叔養了很多羊。

ex.en: Sheep are feeding in the meadow.
ex.zh: 羊群在草地上吃草。

sheep.en: a farm animal with thick wool that is kept for its meat and wool

ex.en: They sat in the shade of that big tree.
ex.zh: 他們坐在那棵大樹的樹蔭下。

ex.en: We had a rest in the shade.
ex.zh: 我們在樹蔭下休息。

shade.en: a place that is protected from the sun and is cooler

ex.en: He likes green in a lighter shade.
ex.zh: 他喜歡淺一點的綠色。

ex.en: Do you have this shirt in a darker shade?
ex.zh: 這件襯衫有深一點的顏色嗎？

shade.en: a particular type of a color, lighter or darker

ex.en: Pull down the shade; the sun is too bright.
ex.zh: 把遮陽簾拉下來，太陽太刺眼了。

ex.en: The lamp needs a new shade.
ex.zh: 這盞燈需要換新燈罩。

shade.en: something that covers a window or light to block the light

ex.en: We went walking on the shore of the lake.
ex.zh: 我們沿著湖岸散步。

ex.en: I found a beautiful shell on the shore.
ex.zh: 我在海邊撿到一個漂亮的貝殼。

ex.en: Now, get off the boat and swim to shore.
ex.zh: 現在下船，游到岸邊。

shore.en: the land along the edge of the sea or a lake

ex.en: The company cut costs to shore up its profits.
ex.zh: 公司削減成本以鞏固獲利。

ex.en: The government took steps to shore up the economy.
ex.zh: 政府採取措施支撐經濟。

shore.en: to make something stronger when it is weak

ex.en: Is this river shallow?
ex.zh: 這條河很淺嗎？

ex.en: Children should swim in the shallow end of the pool.
ex.zh: 小孩應該在泳池淺水區游泳。

ex.en: Between you and me, he's a shallow thinker.
ex.zh: 私下跟你說，他的想法很膚淺。

ex.en: Tom is shallow.
ex.zh: 湯姆很膚淺。

shallow.en: not interested in or thinking about important things

ex.en: The secretary took notes in shorthand during the meeting.
ex.zh: 祕書在會議中用速記做筆記。

ex.en: Few people learn shorthand these days.
ex.zh: 現在很少人學速記了。

shorthand.en: a fast way of writing using special signs instead of letters

ex.en: "ASAP" is shorthand for "as soon as possible."
ex.zh: 「ASAP」是「as soon as possible」的縮寫。

ex.en: We use the word "sync" as shorthand for a quick meeting.
ex.zh: 我們用「sync」這個詞當作簡短會議的簡稱。

shorthand.en: a short way of saying something longer

ex.en: His face reddened with shame.
ex.zh: 他的臉因羞恥而變紅了。

ex.en: I think death is preferable to shame.
ex.zh: 我覺得士可殺不可辱。

ex.en: Shame on you!
ex.zh: 你真丟臉！

shame.en: an uncomfortable feeling you have when you have done something wrong

shame.zh: 憾事、可惜（常用 It's a shame）

ex.en: What a shame!
ex.zh: 真丟人！

ex.en: It's a crying shame that they weren't insured against fire.
ex.zh: 這簡直是太可惜了，他們沒有買火險。

ex.en: It is a shame not to keep your promise.
ex.zh: 不遵守承諾是可恥的。

shame.en: something that makes you feel sad or sorry

ex.en: The accusations are shocking: money laundering, tax evasion and obstruction of justice.
ex.zh: 這些指控令人震驚:洗錢、逃稅和妨礙司法公正。

ex.en: The shocking news spread quickly through the town.
ex.zh: 這個令人震驚的消息很快傳遍了全鎮。

ex.en: It is shocking how little the workers were paid.
ex.zh: 那些工人的薪水之低，令人震驚。

ex.en: The mere thought of a snake makes me shiver.
ex.zh: 一想到蛇就發顫。

ex.en: I'm shivering with cold.
ex.zh: 我的身體被凍得瑟瑟發抖。

ex.en: You're still shivering.
ex.zh: 你還在發抖。

shiver.en: to shake slightly because you are cold or afraid

ex.en: Your conduct is absolutely shameful.
ex.zh: 你的行為是絕對可恥的。

ex.en: It is shameful to cheat on an exam.
ex.zh: 考試作弊是可恥的。

ex.en: The way they treated the guests was shameful.
ex.zh: 他們對待客人的方式很丟臉。

shameful.en: so bad that you should feel embarrassed about it

ex.en: Cutting the education budget is a shortsighted decision.
ex.zh: 削減教育預算是個目光短淺的決定。

ex.en: It was shortsighted of him to ignore the long-term costs.
ex.zh: 他忽略了長期成本，實在是目光短淺。

shortsighted.en: not thinking about what will happen in the future

ex.en: She is shortsighted and cannot read the board without glasses.
ex.zh: 她近視，不戴眼鏡就看不清黑板。

ex.en: Many shortsighted children wear glasses.
ex.zh: 許多近視的孩子都戴眼鏡。

shortsighted.en: unable to see things clearly when they are far away

ex.en: Yes. She used to be a very shy girl.
ex.zh: 對啊，她以前是一個很害羞的女孩。

ex.en: He is too shy to talk to girls.
ex.zh: 他很害羞，都不敢和女孩子說話。

ex.en: I was too shy to look her in the face.
ex.zh: 我害羞得不敢正面看她的臉。

shy.en: nervous and uncomfortable with other people

ex.en: The factory shutdown left 300 people without jobs.
ex.zh: 工廠停工讓三百人失業。

ex.en: The system will be down during the planned shutdown on Sunday.
ex.zh: 週日預定停機期間，系統將無法使用。

shutdown.en: the stopping of work in a factory, business or machine

ex.en: We had a picnic under a shady tree in the park.
ex.zh: 我們在公園裡一棵有樹蔭的樹下野餐。

ex.en: Let's find a shady spot to sit and chat.
ex.zh: 我們找個陰涼的地方坐下來聊聊吧。

shady.en: protected from the sun, so cool and dark

ex.en: Be careful of shady people who offer you jobs online.
ex.zh: 小心網路上那些提供工作機會的可疑人士。

ex.en: He was involved in some shady business deals.
ex.zh: 他涉入了一些不正當的生意。

ex.en: From the practical point of view, there are many shortcomings in his plan.
ex.zh: 從實際的角度來看，他的計畫有很多缺點。

ex.en: I am not without my shortcomings, but these shortcomings can easily be amended.
ex.zh: 我並非沒有缺點，但這些缺點很容易改正。

ex.en: A good friend accepts your shortcomings and still supports you.
ex.zh: 好朋友會接納你的缺點，依然支持你。

shortcoming.en: a fault or weakness in someone or something

ex.en: I work for a shipping company.
ex.zh: 我在一家航運公司上班。

ex.en: Shipping is free for orders over 1,000 dollars.
ex.zh: 訂單滿一千元免運費。

shipping.en: the sending of goods to customers, or the cost of this

ex.en: Your name is on the shortlist for the job.
ex.zh: 你已經進入這份工作的候選名單。

ex.en: We have a shortlist of three candidates.
ex.zh: 我們有三位入圍的候選人。

shortlist.en: a small group of the best people chosen from a larger group for a final choice

ex.en: She was shortlisted for the award.
ex.zh: 她入圍了這個獎項。

ex.en: Only five applicants will be shortlisted.
ex.zh: 只有五位應徵者會進入候選名單。

shortlist.en: to put someone on a small list of the best choices

ex.en: There was a shortage of fuel.
ex.zh: 燃料短缺。

ex.en: Due to the water shortage, all the flowers in the garden have died.
ex.zh: 因為缺水，花園裡的花全都死了。

ex.en: The recent coffee shortage brought about many problems.
ex.zh: 最近的咖啡短缺帶來了許多問題。

shortage.en: a situation in which there is not enough of something

ex.en: This product has a shelf life of twelve months.
ex.zh: 這項產品的保存期限是十二個月。

ex.en: Check the shelf life before placing the order.
ex.zh: 下單前請確認保存期限。

shelf life.en: the length of time a product can be kept before it is no longer good

ex.en: The shipper provided a tracking number by email.
ex.zh: 託運人透過電子郵件提供了追蹤號碼。

ex.en: Please contact the shipper about the damaged package.
ex.zh: 包裹受損的事請聯絡寄件人。

shipper.en: a person or company that sends goods to somewhere

ex.en: How long does it take for the airport shuttle to get to the airport?
ex.zh: 機場接駁車到機場要多久？

ex.en: The hotel runs a free shuttle to the airport.
ex.zh: 飯店有免費的機場接駁車。

shuttle.en: a bus or plane that travels regularly between two places

ex.en: This is the shortcut that I usually take to school.
ex.zh: 這是我平常上學走的捷徑。

ex.en: There is no shortcut to success.
ex.zh: 成功是沒有捷徑的。

shortcut.en: a quicker and more direct way to get somewhere

ex.en: I created a shortcut on the desktop.
ex.zh: 我在桌面上建立了一個捷徑。

ex.en: Use this keyboard shortcut to save time.
ex.zh: 用這個快速鍵可以節省時間。

shortcut.en: a quick way to open a file or do a task on a computer

ex.en: There are many ships in the harbor.
ex.zh: 港口內有許多船。

ex.en: Modern ships only need a small crew.
ex.zh: 現代船隻只需要一小組的船員。

ex.en: A woman fell from a ship into the sea.
ex.zh: 有個女人從船上掉進了海里。

ship.en: a large boat that carries people or goods across the sea

ex.en: We will ship your order tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我們明天會寄出您的訂單。

ex.en: The products are shipped from Taiwan.
ex.zh: 這些產品從台灣出貨。

ship.en: to send goods to a customer

ex.en: In case the shipment is delayed, we have special delay insurance.
ex.zh: 萬一貨運延誤，我們有特別的延誤保險。

ex.en: The shipment arrived two days late.
ex.zh: 這批貨晚了兩天到。

shipment.en: a load of goods sent together, or the act of sending them

ex.en: Put old documents in the shredder.
ex.zh: 把舊文件放進碎紙機。

ex.en: The shredder is full again.
ex.zh: 碎紙機又滿了。

shredder.en: a machine that cuts paper into very small pieces

ex.en: Tom is working the night shift.
ex.zh: 湯姆上夜班。

ex.en: I start my morning shift at 7 a.m.
ex.zh: 我的早班早上 7 點開始。

shift.en: a period of work, or a group of workers who work at a certain time

ex.en: As tectonic plates shifted, uniquely adapted species of dinosaur emerged on each continent through vicariance.
ex.zh: 隨著板塊移動，各大洲因為地理隔離，演化出了適應不同環境的獨特恐龍。

ex.en: Public opinion has shifted in recent years.
ex.zh: 近年來輿論已經轉變了。

shift.en: to move to a different place or to change

ex.en: My mother loves shopping on weekends.
ex.zh: 我媽媽很喜歡在週末購物。

ex.en: We did our Christmas shopping online this year.
ex.zh: 今年我們在網路上買聖誕節的東西。

ex.en: Shopping with kids can be tiring.
ex.zh: 帶小孩一起購物可能很累人。

ex.en: He goes to a shooting range on weekends.
ex.zh: 他週末會去射擊場。

ex.en: Shooting is an Olympic sport.
ex.zh: 射擊是奧運項目。

ex.en: The shooting of the film took six months.
ex.zh: 這部電影的拍攝花了六個月。

ex.en: They finished shooting the last scene yesterday.
ex.zh: 他們昨天拍完了最後一場戲。

ex.en: He shrugged and said he didn't know.
ex.zh: 他聳聳肩說他不知道。

ex.en: She shrugged her shoulders and walked away.
ex.zh: 她聳了聳肩就走開了。

ex.en: I asked him why, but all I got was a shrug.
ex.zh: 我問他為什麼，他只是聳了聳肩。

ex.en: With a shrug, she turned back to her book.
ex.zh: 她聳了聳肩，又回頭看她的書。

ex.en: We have a shared kitchen on this floor.
ex.zh: 這層樓我們共用一間廚房。

ex.en: They have a shared interest in photography.
ex.zh: 他們對攝影有共同的興趣。

ex.en: We ordered fried shrimp with rice.
ex.zh: 我們點了炸蝦配飯。

ex.en: The soup is full of fresh shrimp and vegetables.
ex.zh: 這碗湯裡有很多新鮮的蝦子和蔬菜。

ex.en: Someone shoved me in the crowded train.
ex.zh: 擁擠的火車上有人用力推了我一下。

ex.en: He shoved his books into his bag and ran out.
ex.zh: 他把書塞進書包就跑了出去。

ex.en: He gave the heavy door a hard shove.
ex.zh: 他用力推了那扇沉重的門一下。

ex.en: With one shove, the box slid across the floor.
ex.zh: 一推之下，箱子滑過地板。

ex.en: We saw a shark swimming near the boat.
ex.zh: 我們看到一隻鯊魚在船邊游過。

ex.en: Sharks can smell blood from far away.
ex.zh: 鯊魚能從很遠的地方聞到血的味道。

ex.en: Be careful, he is a card shark.
ex.zh: 小心，他是個牌桌上的老手。

ex.en: The loan shark asked for too much interest.
ex.zh: 那個放高利貸的人要求的利息太高了。

ex.en: The shaft of the arrow was made of bamboo.
ex.zh: 這支箭的箭桿是用竹子做的。

ex.en: A broken shaft stopped the machine from working.
ex.zh: 一根斷掉的傳動軸讓機器停止運轉。

ex.en: The workers climbed down the mine shaft carefully.
ex.zh: 工人們小心地爬下礦井。

ex.en: Someone dropped a coin down the elevator shaft.
ex.zh: 有人把硬幣掉進了電梯井裡。

ex.en: It was so hot that I wore shorts all day.
ex.zh: 天氣太熱了，我整天都穿短褲。

ex.en: He packed two pairs of shorts for the beach trip.
ex.zh: 他為海邊旅行打包了兩條短褲。

ex.en: She works at a small bookstore near the park.
ex.zh: 她在公園附近的一家小書店工作。

ex.en: I asked my mother where she put the keys.
ex.zh: 我問媽媽她把鑰匙放在哪裡。

ex.en: She is learning how to play the piano.
ex.zh: 她正在學彈鋼琴。

ex.en: You should drink more water every day.
ex.zh: 你每天應該多喝水。

ex.en: We should leave early to avoid the traffic.
ex.zh: 我們應該早點出發以避開塞車。

ex.en: The package should arrive by Friday.
ex.zh: 包裹應該會在星期五前送到。

ex.en: It should be sunny tomorrow, according to the forecast.
ex.zh: 根據預報，明天應該會放晴。

ex.en: I shall return the book to you next week.
ex.zh: 我下星期會把書還給你。

ex.en: We shall never forget your kindness.
ex.zh: 我們永遠不會忘記你的好意。

ex.en: Shall we go for a walk after dinner?
ex.zh: 晚餐後我們去散步好嗎？

ex.en: Shall I open the window for you?
ex.zh: 要不要我幫你把窗戶打開？

ex.en: Sheffield is a city in the north of England.
ex.zh: 雪菲爾是英格蘭北部的一座城市。

ex.en: She studied engineering at a university in Sheffield.
ex.zh: 她在雪菲爾的一所大學念工程。

ex.en: Shakespeare wrote many famous plays, including Hamlet and Macbeth.
ex.zh: 莎士比亞寫了許多著名的劇本，包括《哈姆雷特》和《馬克白》。

ex.en: We read a short scene by Shakespeare in English class.
ex.zh: 我們在英文課上讀了一小段莎士比亞的劇作。

ex.en: She was shocked to hear the sudden news.
ex.zh: 她聽到這個突如其來的消息時嚇了一跳。

ex.en: We were all shocked by how expensive the bill was.
ex.zh: 帳單貴得離譜，我們都嚇到了。

sheriff.zh: 郡治安官（美國地方執法首長）

ex.en: The sheriff asked the neighbors if they had seen anything.
ex.zh: 郡治安官詢問鄰居們有沒有看到什麼。

ex.en: In many Western movies, the sheriff wears a silver star.
ex.zh: 在許多西部電影裡，治安官會戴著銀色星形徽章。

ex.en: The county voted for a new sheriff last November.
ex.zh: 這個郡去年十一月選出了新的治安官。

ex.en: She polished her shoes until they were shiny.
ex.zh: 她把鞋子擦到發亮。

ex.en: The baby was playing with a shiny new coin.
ex.zh: 寶寶正在玩一枚閃亮的新硬幣。

ex.en: The car looked shiny after a good wash.
ex.zh: 洗過車之後，這輛車看起來閃閃發亮。

ex.en: The farmer kept a shotgun in the barn.
ex.zh: 農夫把一把霰彈槍放在穀倉裡。

ex.en: Hunters need a license to carry a shotgun.
ex.zh: 獵人需要有執照才能持有霰彈槍。

ex.en: I call shotgun, so you two sit in the back.
ex.zh: 我要坐副駕駛座，你們兩個坐後面。

ex.en: He always rides shotgun when his dad drives.
ex.zh: 爸爸開車時，他總是坐在副駕駛座。

ex.en: The glass fell on the floor and shattered.
ex.zh: 玻璃掉到地上摔碎了。

ex.en: A loud noise shattered the silence of the night.
ex.zh: 一聲巨響打破了夜晚的寂靜。

ex.en: The bad news shattered her hopes of winning.
ex.zh: 壞消息粉碎了她獲勝的希望。

ex.en: His confidence was shattered by the failure.
ex.zh: 那次失敗讓他的自信心徹底崩潰。

shah.zh: 沙阿（伊朗等地君主的稱號）

ex.en: The shah was the title of the monarch in Iran before 1979.
ex.zh: 在 1979 年以前，沙阿是伊朗君主的稱號。

ex.en: The book tells the story of a shah and his royal court.
ex.zh: 這本書講述一位沙阿與他的宮廷的故事。

ex.en: A shilling was a British coin used before decimal money began in 1971.
ex.zh: 先令是英國舊時的硬幣，在 1971 年改用十進位貨幣之前使用。

ex.en: In the old book, the boy buys a loaf of bread for a shilling.
ex.zh: 在那本舊書裡，男孩用一先令買了一條麵包。

ex.en: He shaves every morning before going to work.
ex.zh: 他每天早上上班前都會刮鬍子。

ex.en: She shaved her legs before going to the beach.
ex.zh: 她去海邊前刮了腿毛。

ex.en: I need a shave before the interview tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我明天面試前得先刮個鬍子。

ex.en: He gave himself a quick shave and left the house.
ex.zh: 他快速刮了鬍子就出門了。

ex.en: That truck missed us by inches; it was a close shave.
ex.zh: 那輛卡車差幾英寸就撞到我們，真是險啊。

ex.en: We had a close shave when the brakes failed on the hill.
ex.zh: 煞車在山坡上失靈時，我們險些出事。

ex.en: We visited a quiet shrine at the top of the hill.
ex.zh: 我們參觀了山頂上一座安靜的神社。

ex.en: Many people stop at the shrine to pray for good luck.
ex.zh: 許多人會在神社前停下來祈求好運。

ex.en: The house has a small shrine for the family's ancestors.
ex.zh: 這棟房子裡有一座供奉家族祖先的小神龕。

ex.en: A small shrub grows beside the front door.
ex.zh: 大門旁邊長著一叢小灌木。

ex.en: We planted several shrubs along the fence.
ex.zh: 我們沿著圍籬種了幾叢灌木。

ex.en: Birds built a nest in the thick shrub.
ex.zh: 鳥兒在濃密的灌木叢裡築了巢。

ex.en: The shepherd led his sheep up the hill.
ex.zh: 牧羊人帶著羊群上山。

ex.en: A shepherd stays with the flock all day.
ex.zh: 牧羊人整天都跟著羊群。

ex.en: The guide shepherded the tourists through the busy market.
ex.zh: 導遊帶領遊客穿過熱鬧的市場。

ex.en: Teachers shepherded the children onto the bus.
ex.zh: 老師們引導孩子們上了公車。

ex.en: Police are looking for the shooter in the case.
ex.zh: 警方正在尋找這起案件的開槍者。

ex.en: The shooter on the hunting team has excellent aim.
ex.zh: 狩獵隊裡的射手瞄得非常準。

ex.en: My brother spends his weekends playing a shooter on his computer.
ex.zh: 我哥哥週末都在電腦上玩射擊遊戲。

ex.en: Many players prefer a first-person shooter with online teams.
ex.zh: 許多玩家偏好可以線上組隊的第一人稱射擊遊戲。

ex.en: I shudder when I think about that cold night.
ex.zh: 一想到那個寒冷的夜晚，我就會發抖。

ex.en: The old bus shuddered as it started to move.
ex.zh: 那輛老舊的公車起步時震顫了一下。

ex.en: A shudder ran through her body.
ex.zh: 一陣顫抖竄過她的全身。

ex.en: He felt a shudder of fear in the dark hallway.
ex.zh: 在漆黑的走廊裡，他感到一陣恐懼的戰慄。

ex.en: Please shuffle the cards before we start the game.
ex.zh: 開始遊戲前請先洗牌。

ex.en: He shuffled the deck three times.
ex.zh: 他把牌洗了三次。

ex.en: The sleepy boy shuffled into the kitchen in his slippers.
ex.zh: 昏昏欲睡的男孩穿著拖鞋拖著腳走進廚房。

ex.en: Old men shuffled slowly along the park path.
ex.zh: 老先生們沿著公園小徑慢慢拖著腳步前進。

ex.en: I set my music player to shuffle during the drive.
ex.zh: 開車時我把音樂播放器設成隨機播放。

ex.en: Set the playlist to shuffle so the songs play in random order.
ex.zh: 把播放清單設成隨機播放，歌曲就會亂序播放。

ex.en: He grabbed a shovel to clear the snow from the driveway.
ex.zh: 他拿起鏟子清除車道上的積雪。

ex.en: The gardener dug a hole with a small shovel.
ex.zh: 園丁用一把小鏟子挖了個洞。

ex.en: They shoveled sand into the wheelbarrow.
ex.zh: 他們把沙子鏟進手推車裡。

ex.en: Dad shoveled the path to the front door.
ex.zh: 爸爸鏟出了通往前門的小路。

ex.en: The children ran toward the shining lake.
ex.zh: 孩子們跑向波光閃閃的湖。

ex.en: She wore a shining silver necklace to the party.
ex.zh: 她戴著閃亮的銀項鍊去參加派對。

ex.en: They spent the night in an old wooden shack by the river.
ex.zh: 他們在河邊一間舊木屋裡過夜。

ex.en: The farmer kept his tools in a tiny shack behind the field.
ex.zh: 農夫把工具放在田地後面的一間小棚屋裡。

ex.en: The festival will showcase local music and food.
ex.zh: 這個慶典將展現當地的音樂和美食。

ex.en: She used her website to showcase her photography.
ex.zh: 她用自己的網站展示她的攝影作品。

ex.en: The museum keeps the old coins in a glass showcase.
ex.zh: 博物館把古錢幣放在玻璃展示櫃裡。

ex.en: The concert was a showcase for young local musicians.
ex.zh: 這場音樂會是年輕本地音樂人展現才華的舞台。

shifting.zh: 移動；轉移（shift 的現在分詞）

ex.en: He kept shifting in his seat during the long speech.
ex.zh: 那場長篇演講中他一直在座位上動來動去。

ex.en: They are shifting the furniture to make room for the piano.
ex.zh: 他們正在搬動家具，為鋼琴騰出空間。

ex.en: The shifting sand made it hard to walk.
ex.zh: 不斷移動的沙子讓人很難行走。

ex.en: The company faces a shifting market every year.
ex.zh: 這家公司每年都面對不斷變動的市場。

ex.en: He sharpened the pencil before the exam.
ex.zh: 他在考試前把鉛筆削尖。

ex.en: Please sharpen the kitchen knives this weekend.
ex.zh: 這個週末請把廚房的刀磨利。

ex.en: Daily practice will sharpen your skills.
ex.zh: 每天練習會磨練你的技巧。

ex.en: Reading helps sharpen your mind.
ex.zh: 閱讀有助於讓你的頭腦更敏銳。

ex.en: We found a sheltered spot to eat out of the wind.
ex.zh: 我們找到一處避風的地方吃東西。

ex.en: The boats stayed in the sheltered bay during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴風雨期間，船隻都停在有遮蔽的海灣裡。

sheltered.zh: 養尊處優的；不諳世事的

ex.en: She had a sheltered childhood in a small town.
ex.zh: 她在小鎮度過了受到呵護的童年。

ex.en: He grew up sheltered and knew little about the real world.
ex.zh: 他在溫室中長大，對真實世界所知不多。

ex.en: She poured a small glass of sherry before dinner.
ex.zh: 她在晚餐前倒了一小杯雪利酒。

ex.en: Sherry comes from the south of Spain.
ex.zh: 雪利酒產自西班牙南部。

ex.en: The ladder felt shaky under his feet.
ex.zh: 梯子在他腳下感覺搖搖晃晃。

ex.en: Her voice was shaky when she started the speech.
ex.zh: 她開始演講時聲音在顫抖。

ex.en: The team had a shaky start this season.
ex.zh: 這支球隊本季開局並不穩。

ex.en: His excuse sounds pretty shaky to me.
ex.zh: 他的藉口聽起來很站不住腳。

ex.en: Shiites make up a large part of the population in Iran.
ex.zh: 什葉派教徒佔了伊朗人口的大部分。

ex.en: The book explains the history of Sunnis and Shiites.
ex.zh: 這本書解釋了遜尼派與什葉派的歷史。

ex.en: The Shetland Islands lie off the north coast of Scotland.
ex.zh: 設得蘭群島位於蘇格蘭北岸外海。

ex.en: Small Shetland ponies are popular with children.
ex.zh: 小型的設得蘭矮種馬很受孩子歡迎。

ex.en: Sh! The baby is finally asleep.
ex.zh: 噓！寶寶終於睡著了。

ex.en: Sh, the movie is starting.
ex.zh: 噓，電影要開始了。

ex.en: The shopkeeper greeted every customer with a smile.
ex.zh: 店主笑著招呼每位顧客。

ex.en: I asked the shopkeeper where I could find batteries.
ex.zh: 我問店主哪裡可以買到電池。

ex.en: She bought a heart-shaped box for her sister's birthday.
ex.zh: 她買了一個心形的盒子當妹妹的生日禮物。

ex.en: The cookies were shaped like little stars.
ex.zh: 這些餅乾被做成小星星的形狀。

ex.en: He lives in an L-shaped apartment near the station.
ex.zh: 他住在車站附近一間L形的公寓。

shaped.zh: 塑造、形成（shape 的過去式）

ex.en: Her childhood in the countryside shaped the way she sees the world.
ex.zh: 她在鄉下的童年塑造了她看世界的方式。

ex.en: The potter shaped the clay into a small bowl.
ex.zh: 陶藝家把黏土捏成一個小碗。

ex.en: She is a shrewd businesswoman who rarely makes mistakes.
ex.zh: 她是個很少犯錯的精明女商人。

ex.en: He made a shrewd guess about what they wanted.
ex.zh: 他精準地猜到了他們想要什麼。

ex.en: A shrewd shopper compares prices first.
ex.zh: 精明的購物者會先比價。

ex.en: There is not a shred of evidence to support his story.
ex.zh: 沒有一絲證據能支持他的說法。

ex.en: The flag was torn into shreds by the strong wind.
ex.zh: 那面旗子被強風撕成了碎片。

ex.en: Please shred these old documents before throwing them away.
ex.zh: 請在丟掉這些舊文件之前先把它們碎掉。

ex.en: I shredded the cabbage for the salad.
ex.zh: 我把高麗菜切成細絲做沙拉。

ex.en: She closed the wooden shutters to block the sun.
ex.zh: 她關上木製百葉窗來擋住陽光。

ex.en: The shutters rattled in the strong wind.
ex.zh: 百葉窗在強風中喀喀作響。

ex.en: The photographer pressed the shutter and took a picture.
ex.zh: 攝影師按下快門拍了一張照片。

ex.en: A fast shutter speed lets you freeze a moving subject.
ex.zh: 快門速度快就能凍結移動中的主體。

ex.en: After the argument, she shunned her old friends.
ex.zh: 吵架之後，她刻意避開老朋友。

ex.en: Many people shun crowded places during the flu season.
ex.zh: 流感季節時，許多人會避開擁擠的地方。

ex.en: We walked along the shoreline at sunset.
ex.zh: 我們在日落時沿著海岸線散步。

ex.en: The storm changed the shape of the shoreline.
ex.zh: 暴風雨改變了海岸線的形狀。

ex.en: The children shrieked with joy at the beach.
ex.zh: 孩子們在海邊開心地尖叫。

ex.en: She shrieked when she saw a mouse.
ex.zh: 她看到老鼠時尖叫了起來。

ex.en: A loud shriek came from the next room.
ex.zh: 隔壁房間傳來一聲大叫。

ex.en: He let out a shriek of surprise.
ex.zh: 他驚訝地尖叫了一聲。

ex.en: The farmer shears the sheep every spring.
ex.zh: 農夫每年春天都會替羊剪毛。

ex.en: It takes about ten minutes to shear one sheep.
ex.zh: 剪一隻羊的毛大約需要十分鐘。

ex.en: The strong wind can shear the top off a small tree.
ex.zh: 強風可能把小樹的樹頂折斷。

ex.en: The machine can shear thick metal sheets with ease.
ex.zh: 這台機器可以輕鬆剪斷厚金屬板。

ex.en: He bought a new pair of shears for the garden.
ex.zh: 他為花園買了一把新的大剪刀。

ex.en: The bridge was damaged by shear forces during the earthquake.
ex.zh: 這座橋在地震中受到剪力破壞。

shattered.zh: 粉碎；破碎（shatter 的過去式／過去分詞）

ex.en: The glass fell and shattered on the kitchen floor.
ex.zh: 玻璃杯掉在廚房地板上摔碎了。

ex.en: The ball shattered the window of our neighbor's house.
ex.zh: 那顆球打碎了鄰居家的窗戶。

ex.en: She was shattered when she heard the news.
ex.zh: 她聽到消息時整個人崩潰了。

ex.en: His shattered dreams were hard to forget.
ex.zh: 他破碎的夢想讓他難以忘懷。

ex.en: I'm absolutely shattered after that long flight.
ex.zh: 搭完那趟長途飛機，我累壞了。

ex.en: You look shattered, so go and get some sleep.
ex.zh: 你看起來累壞了，快去睡一下吧。

ex.en: A shadowy figure stood at the end of the street.
ex.zh: 街尾站著一個朦朧的身影。

ex.en: The shadowy corner of the room felt cold.
ex.zh: 房間陰暗的角落感覺很冷。

showing.zh: 展示、給…看（show 的現在分詞）

ex.en: She is showing her friends photos from the trip.
ex.zh: 她正在給朋友們看旅行的照片。

ex.en: He was showing me how to cook rice.
ex.zh: 他正在教我怎麼煮飯。

ex.en: There is a late showing of the film at ten.
ex.zh: 這部電影十點有一場晚場放映。

ex.en: The gallery's showing of local art starts on Friday.
ex.zh: 畫廊的本地藝術展星期五開始。

ex.en: The team made a strong showing in the finals.
ex.zh: 那支隊伍在決賽中表現亮眼。

ex.en: Her showing on the test was disappointing.
ex.zh: 她這次考試的表現令人失望。

shimmering.zh: 閃閃發光（shimmer 的現在分詞）

ex.en: The lake was shimmering in the morning sun.
ex.zh: 湖面在晨光下閃閃發亮。

ex.en: Her dress was shimmering under the bright lights.
ex.zh: 她的洋裝在明亮的燈光下閃爍著微光。

ex.en: The two leaders had a showdown over the budget.
ex.zh: 兩位領導人為了預算而攤牌。

ex.en: Tonight's showdown between the top teams will decide the champion.
ex.zh: 今晚兩強隊伍的對決將決定冠軍。

ex.en: I need to buy a new bottle of shampoo.
ex.zh: 我需要買一瓶新的洗髮精。

ex.en: This shampoo smells like green apples.
ex.zh: 這款洗髮精聞起來像青蘋果。

ex.en: Shampoo your hair twice a week.
ex.zh: 一週洗兩次頭。

ex.en: She shampooed the dog in the bathtub.
ex.zh: 她在浴缸裡幫狗洗澡。

ex.en: Yorkshire is a large shire in northern England.
ex.zh: 約克郡是英格蘭北部的一個大郡。

ex.en: The old shire was divided into smaller districts.
ex.zh: 這個古老的郡後來被分成幾個較小的行政區。

ex.en: He wore a shabby coat with holes in the sleeves.
ex.zh: 他穿著一件袖子破洞的舊外套。

ex.en: The hotel looked shabby, with peeling paint and old carpets.
ex.zh: 這間旅館看起來很破舊，油漆剝落、地毯老舊。

ex.en: It was a shabby trick to take credit for her work.
ex.zh: 把她的成果據為己有是很卑劣的手段。

ex.en: They gave us shabby treatment after all our hard work.
ex.zh: 在我們辛苦付出之後，他們卻這樣不公平地對待我們。

ex.en: She has a small shareholding in the company.
ex.zh: 她持有這家公司一小部分的股份。

ex.en: The family's shareholding gives them a strong voice in decisions.
ex.zh: 這個家族的持股讓他們在決策上很有發言權。

ex.en: The shortstop caught the ball and threw it to first base.
ex.zh: 游擊手接住球，傳給一壘。

ex.en: My brother plays shortstop on the school baseball team.
ex.zh: 我弟弟在學校棒球隊擔任游擊手。

ex.en: She cut her foot on a shard of glass.
ex.zh: 她的腳被一片玻璃碎片割傷了。

ex.en: Archaeologists found a shard of an ancient clay pot.
ex.zh: 考古學家發現了一塊古代陶罐的碎片。

sharing.zh: 分享；共用（share 的現在分詞）

ex.en: We are sharing a pizza for lunch.
ex.zh: 我們午餐一起分著吃一個披薩。

ex.en: She is sharing her notes with the whole class.
ex.zh: 她正在和全班分享她的筆記。

ex.en: Sharing is an important habit for children to learn.
ex.zh: 分享是孩子們該學會的重要習慣。

ex.en: Car sharing can save money and reduce traffic.
ex.zh: 共乘汽車可以省錢並減少交通。

shields.zh: 盾牌；保護物（shield 的複數）

ex.en: The knights carried heavy shields into battle.
ex.zh: 騎士們帶著沉重的盾牌上戰場。

ex.en: Sunscreen and hats are shields against the strong sun.
ex.zh: 防曬乳和帽子能抵擋強烈的陽光。

ex.en: A skilled shearer can remove a sheep's wool in just a few minutes.
ex.zh: 熟練的剪毛工幾分鐘就能剪下一隻羊的毛。

ex.en: The shearer arrived at the farm early in the spring.
ex.zh: 剪毛工在春天一早就抵達了農場。

ex.en: Shh, the baby is finally asleep.
ex.zh: 噓，寶寶終於睡著了。

ex.en: "Shh!" she whispered. "Someone is coming."
ex.zh: 「噓！」她小聲說：「有人來了。」

ex.en: Fry the chopped shallot in a little oil until it turns golden.
ex.zh: 把切碎的紅蔥頭用少許油炸到金黃。

ex.en: A shallot has a milder flavor than a regular onion.
ex.zh: 紅蔥頭的味道比一般洋蔥溫和。

ex.en: The roof needs new shingles after the storm.
ex.zh: 暴風雨後，屋頂需要換新的瓦片。

ex.en: Each wooden shingle was cut by hand.
ex.zh: 每一片木瓦都是手工切成的。

ex.en: We walked along the shingle beach looking for pretty stones.
ex.zh: 我們沿著鋪滿卵石的海灘走，尋找漂亮的石頭。

ex.en: Waves rolled the shingle back and forth.
ex.zh: 海浪把卵石來回沖刷。

ex.en: The shrinking ice is a problem for polar bears.
ex.zh: 不斷縮小的冰層對北極熊是個問題。

ex.en: The village has a shrinking population as young people leave.
ex.zh: 隨著年輕人離開，這個村莊的人口愈來愈少。

ex.en: My savings are shrinking every month.
ex.zh: 我的存款每個月都在縮減。

ex.en: The sweater is shrinking in the wash.
ex.zh: 這件毛衣洗了之後正在縮水。

ex.en: He kicked the table and hurt his shin.
ex.zh: 他踢到桌子，弄傷了小腿前側。

ex.en: Soccer players wear guards to protect their shins.
ex.zh: 足球員戴護脛來保護小腿。

ex.en: The village shaman performed a ceremony for rain.
ex.zh: 村裡的薩滿舉行了祈雨儀式。

ex.en: In some cultures, a shaman is believed to talk with spirits.
ex.zh: 在某些文化中，薩滿被認為能與靈溝通。

ex.en: She wrapped a warm shawl around her shoulders.
ex.zh: 她把一條暖和的披肩圍在肩上。

ex.en: My grandmother knitted this wool shawl.
ex.zh: 這條羊毛披肩是我奶奶織的。

ex.en: He walked into the room shuffling his feet in tired slippers.
ex.zh: 他穿著疲憊的拖鞋，拖著腳步走進房間。

ex.en: The old man was shuffling slowly down the hallway.
ex.zh: 老先生正慢慢地拖著腳步走過走廊。

ex.en: She is shuffling the cards before we start the game.
ex.zh: 在我們開始遊戲前，她正在洗牌。

ex.en: Shuffling the deck well makes the game fair.
ex.zh: 把牌洗好，遊戲才公平。

ex.en: He kept shuffling papers on his desk while he talked.
ex.zh: 他一邊講話，一邊不停翻動桌上的文件。

ex.en: The manager is shuffling the schedule to fit everyone in.
ex.zh: 經理正在調整時間表，好讓每個人都排得進去。

ex.en: The shrill whistle woke everyone up.
ex.zh: 刺耳的哨聲把大家吵醒了。

ex.en: She has a shrill voice when she gets excited.
ex.zh: 她一興奮聲音就會變得尖銳。

ex.en: The alarm shrilled through the empty building.
ex.zh: 警報器在空蕩的大樓裡發出刺耳的尖鳴。

ex.en: Birds shrilled from the trees at dawn.
ex.zh: 黎明時，鳥在樹上發出尖銳的鳴叫。

ex.en: My grandfather worked in a shipyard for thirty years.
ex.zh: 我祖父在造船廠工作了三十年。

ex.en: A new cargo ship is being built at the shipyard.
ex.zh: 一艘新的貨輪正在造船廠建造中。

ex.en: The company ran a sham charity to collect money.
ex.zh: 那家公司開設了一個假慈善機構來斂財。

ex.en: It was a sham marriage made only for the papers.
ex.zh: 那是一場只為了拿證件而辦的假婚姻。

ex.en: The election was a sham because the result was decided in advance.
ex.zh: 那場選舉是個騙局，因為結果早就決定好了。

ex.en: He realized the whole offer was a sham.
ex.zh: 他發現整個優惠都是騙人的。

ex.en: He shammed illness to stay home from school.
ex.zh: 他假裝生病不去上學。

ex.en: She shammed sleep so that she wouldn't have to talk.
ex.zh: 她假裝睡著，這樣就不用說話。

ex.en: Shipbuilding was once the main industry in the town.
ex.zh: 造船業曾是這個小鎮的主要產業。

ex.en: He works in shipbuilding and designs large boats.
ex.zh: 他從事造船業，設計大型船隻。

ex.en: The butcher cut a lamb shank for the stew.
ex.zh: 肉販切了一塊羊腿肉來燉湯。

ex.en: Hold the tool by its shank, not by the sharp end.
ex.zh: 握住工具的柄，不要握尖的那端。

ex.en: The knight pulled his sword from its sheath.
ex.zh: 騎士從鞘中拔出劍。

ex.en: Put the knife back in its sheath before you walk away.
ex.zh: 走開之前先把刀放回刀鞘。

ex.en: The silk scarf had a soft sheen in the light.

ex.zh: 她穿著內裡是羊皮的靴子。

ex.en: A sheepskin rug lay in front of the fireplace.
ex.zh: 壁爐前鋪著一張羊皮地毯。

ex.en: Remove the shuck from the corn before cooking.
ex.zh: 煮玉米前先剝掉外皮。

ex.en: A pile of oyster shucks lay beside the table.
ex.zh: 桌邊堆著一堆牡蠣殼。

ex.en: He shucked the corn and put it in boiling water.
ex.zh: 他把玉米剝了殼，放進滾水裡。

ex.en: She shucked off her wet boots at the door.
ex.zh: 她在門口脫掉濕靴子。

ex.en: A shirtless man was running along the beach.
ex.zh: 一名打赤膊的男子沿著海灘跑步。

ex.en: The boys played shirtless in the hot summer sun.
ex.zh: 男孩們在炎熱的夏日陽光下打著赤膊玩耍。

ex.en: My shoelace came undone while I was running.
ex.zh: 我跑步時鞋帶鬆開了。

ex.en: He taught his little sister how to tie a shoelace.
ex.zh: 他教妹妹怎麼綁鞋帶。

ex.en: Wash the shirt in cold water to reduce shrinkage.
ex.zh: 用冷水洗襯衫可以減少縮水。

ex.en: The factory reported shrinkage in sales this quarter.
ex.zh: 工廠報告本季銷售額縮減。

ex.en: In the old play, the main character is a famous shrew.
ex.zh: 在那齣老戲劇裡，主角是個出了名的潑婦。

ex.en: He called her a shrew, and she was furious.
ex.zh: 他罵她是潑婦，她氣壞了。

showman.zh: 表演主持人；善於表演的人

ex.en: The circus showman greeted the crowd with a big smile.
ex.zh: 馬戲團的主持人笑容滿面地迎接觀眾。

ex.en: He is a real showman who knows how to excite an audience.
ex.zh: 他真是個很會炒熱氣氛的表演高手。

ex.en: We put new shelving in the garage.
ex.zh: 我們在車庫裝了新的架子。

ex.en: The shelving holds all my books and files.
ex.zh: 這些擱板放著我所有的書和文件。

ex.en: He didn't show up for the meeting this morning.
ex.zh: 他今天早上沒有出席會議。

ex.en: Only five people showed up at the party.
ex.zh: 派對上只有五個人出現。

ex.en: The scratches show up clearly in this light.
ex.zh: 在這種光線下，刮痕看得很清楚。

ex.en: The problem didn't show up until we tested the system.
ex.zh: 直到測試系統時，問題才浮現出來。

ex.en: She didn't mean to show up her older sister at the contest.
ex.zh: 她無意在比賽中讓姊姊難堪。

ex.en: He loves to show up his coworkers in front of the boss.
ex.zh: 他很愛在老闆面前讓同事出糗。
